stem:
This list describes a battle during the Revolutionary War.

The Battle of Yorktown

• General Washington led troops against British General Cornwallis.

• French and American forces surrounded British troops on a peninsula.

• ?
instruction: Which description of the battle correctly completes the list?

options.label: A
options.text: It was the second battle in the fight for independence.

options.label: B
options.text: It was the first battle fought with the help of foreign forces.

options.label: C
options.text: It was the last major battle of the war.

options.label: D
options.text: It was the battle that helped prolong the war.

visual_elements: The Battle of Yorktown box with bullet points: General Washington led troops against British General Cornwallis, French and American forces surrounded British troops on a peninsula, one bullet with '?'.
